UNMET: [fix-code] PATH-1 | WHY: The requirement says each of the three resume paths "finds the interrupted run's state in `runs/<run_id>/`". The runner's internal auto-resume check (runner.sh:2174) reads `state_file` which is `$state_dir/pipeline-state.json` (line 2073) when `ZBUILD_STATE_FILE` is unset — it does not scan `runs/<run_id>/`. An interrupted run with the default state layout writes its state to `runs/<run_id>/pipeline-state.json` (runner.sh:2240), which the auto-resume check never reads. All three entry-point tests in `resume-entry-points-test.sh` and `resume-rehydrate-test.sh` bypass this location problem by setting `ZBUILD_STATE_FILE` explicitly (e.g. `ZBUILD_STATE_FILE="$P2_STATE_FILE"`) — none of them places state under a `runs/<run_id>/` subdirectory and verifies the runner finds it there. If someone put the old code back, only the rehydration assertions would fail; the specific "finds state in `runs/<run_id>/`" sub-requirement would remain untestable by these tests. | QUOTE: "Every way to resume (`--resume`, auto-resume on restart, and `zbuild pipeline resume --run-id`) finds the interrupted run's state in `runs/<run_id>/` and behaves as R1. Each has its own test."
